🎀 all of my PINK Digital Cameras I collected last year! 📸✨ I’ve shared reviews each of them for over a year now, so here’s a compilation throwback! let me know your faves 💬 check out my “DigiCam” highlights for more! 1. Casio Exilim TR-M11 : a crowd favorite!! a compact powder-inspired 10.5 MP digicam with built-in beauty filters and front flash! totally spies coded 💄 2. Sony Cybershot M2 : my favorite point-and-shoot 5.2 MP camcorder. super unique build, with a spin-and-flip style, and vintage output! (love the Flash on this one) 🎀 3. Casio Exilim ZR70 : my numbawan favorite flipscreen camera with 16.1 MP! bright and clear outputs, ideal for portrait shots. Classy and minimalist design 🩰 4. Casio Exilim ZR5100 : my second favorite flipscreen camera with 12.1 MP. it’s kinda chonky~ this has wide-angle lens and custom make-up mode filters! love the bubblegum pink color sm 👛 5. Casio Exilim FR100L : a unique detachable and flippable camera with a 10.2 MP wide-angle lens, perfect for outdoor vlogs. sturdy build! 🌷 6. Casio Exilim TR-80 : a glam upgrade with 11.1 MP, slim and stylish compact that feels like holding a luxury mirror! with advanced beauty modes, perfect for selfies 🪞 7. Fujifilm FinePix Z700EXR : an ultracompact digicam with 12 MP and touchscreen display! love the rose gold finish, it gives classy girly vibes while still being sleek and practical ⚜️ 8. Fujifilm FinePix 40i : a quirky 2.4 MP compact square camera with built-in MP3 player~ retro gadget vibes! outputs have a soft nostalgic feel. doubles as a music buddy 🎶 9. Fujifilm Instax PAL : a pocket-friendly cutie that’s so smol!! portable for quick snaps and fun moments on the go~ pairs well with Instax printers too 🤏🏻 10. Vtech Kidizoom Pink : a chunky toy camera designed for kids but sooo fun! super durable, playful filters and frames, and even has mini games inside! the bubblegum pink plastic gives it a nostalgic early-2000s feel 🌸 #digitalcamera #digicam #digicamlove #casiotrm11 #pinkdigitalcamera
